description: Rung-6b clinical MANAGEMENT as a dose-feasibility decision — the therapy half of the clinical/MLE bridge, the step past rung-6's differential (which diagnosis) to WHICH THERAPY under the patient's chart. Each item renders a management decision as a scalar constraint program over the drug's dose: it must clear a therapeutic minimum and stay under every ceiling (efficacy/toxicity maximum plus an organ-adjusted cap from the chart — renal, hepatic, age, weight, blood-pressure, or potassium safety). The gold ADJ program declares `symbol dose : scalar`, one `constrain` per bound, and `check`; the ENGINE intersects the constraints (QF_LRA linear feasibility) and returns feasible or infeasible, read by the existing check_outcome extractor — no harness or engine change. The reasoning and the anchoring trap: when an organ-adjusted cap falls BELOW the therapeutic minimum the regimen is INFEASIBLE (the drug cannot be dosed safely AND effectively for this patient, so therapy must be switched); a clinician who checks only whether the therapeutic minimum is reachable, ignoring the chart cap, wrongly calls it feasible. Twenty scenarios across antimicrobials, anticoagulants, analgesics, antiarrhythmics, antiepileptics, endocrine, and oncologic therapy; every numeric bound is stated verbatim in the stem (no-result-literals gate holds); options are the distinct constraint outcomes (feasible / infeasible / unbounded / optimal / unknown). Engine returns the correct feasibility 20/20 in cached mode, zero wrong.

items.stem: A patient with MRSA bacteremia needs vancomycin. For vancomycin, the safe-and-effective dose (in mg per kg per day) must satisfy: the therapeutic trough requires at least 15; the toxicity ceiling caps it at 20; the maximum per-dose limit is 45. Is there a single dose that satisfies every one of these constraints at once (so the regimen is feasible), or do they conflict (infeasible, meaning therapy must be changed)?
items.program:
symbol dose : scalar
constrain dose >= 15
constrain dose <= 20
constrain dose <= 45
check
